summary: Implemented the progress-tracked file reading feature in rich/progress.py: a private _Reader class (read, readline, readlines, readinto, iteration, seek syncing the task position, close), Progress.read(file, total=None, task_id=None, description="Reading...") accepting a path or binary file-like object (total required for file objects), and a module-level rich.progress.read context manager. Added five tests to tests/test_progress.py and a CHANGELOG entry. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the tests are unverified.
